newsitem.title: USA: Carematrix names new execs, sets debt offer.
newsitem.headline: Carematrix names new execs, sets debt offer.

text.p: CareMatrix Corp said it promoted its president, Robert Kaufman, to chief executive officer and named Andrew Gosman as its new president.
Gosman was previously executive vice president at CareMatrix. The chairman of the company is Abraham Gosman.
Separately, CareMatrix said it plans to sell $100 million of convertible debentures.
CareMatrix was not immediately available for further information.
The promotions follow the departure of former chief executive Michael Doyle, who left for another company, CareMatrix later said.
Andrew Gosman was previously executive vice president, heading merger and acquisition activity at CareMatrix.
